summary: Crafty Controller is a dedicated administrative utility for managing Minecraft server instances through a web-based interface. It acts as a launcher and control panel to help you start, stop, and configure game environments without relying solely on manual command-line inputs.
goodFor: It suits server administrators and small communities who want a centralised web interface to manage multiple Minecraft instances on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The repository has low engagement and very few recent commits recorded, meaning you should evaluate its current stability and long-term maintenance status carefully.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker and Python, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your game data and set up a reverse proxy to handle secure HTTPS access.
